# 1780. Check if Number is a Sum of Powers of Three

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def checkPowersOfThree(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        while n:
            if n % 3 == 2:
                return False
            n = n // 3
        return True
```
